results.title: nanoid custom alphabets, sizes and non-secure ids
results.summary: Generate URL-safe ids with nanoid, custom alphabets via customAlphabet, fixed sizes, and nonSecure for sync contexts, asserting uniqueness and alphabet constraints.

results.title: Knex migrations, seeds and queries on better-sqlite3
results.summary: Knex 3 with the better-sqlite3 client: in-code migrations via a custom migrationSource (latest, down, rollback, list), foreign keys enabled per connection, a transactional seed and a join plus aggregate query, tested on in-memory SQLite.

results.title: ArkType 2 schemas with morphs, narrows and discriminated unions
results.summary: Validate and transform data with ArkType 2: object schemas, morph pipes, narrow predicates, and discriminated unions returning typed data or readable problems.

results.title: Arrow date shifting and humanize with clocks frozen by time-machine
results.summary: Shift Arrow dates by calendar units, humanize relative times, and pin the clock with time-machine so the output is deterministic offline.

results.title: attrs models with cattrs structuring, custom datetime hooks and renaming
results.summary: Define attrs classes with validators and converters, then use a cattrs Converter with custom datetime hooks and wire-name renaming, roundtrip through unstructure/structure, and inspect ClassValidationError details. Tested offline.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 DynamoDB document client and SQS events, tested with Vitest matchers
results.summary: A single-table DynamoDB order service on @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb with conditional puts, begins_with queries and optimistic locking, publishing SQS events, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and aws-sdk-client-mock-vitest matchers.

results.title: boto3 DynamoDB idempotency and SQS queue tested offline with moto
results.summary: A DynamoDB conditional put for idempotent writes plus SQS send and receive, tested offline with moto mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: boto3 S3 helper with paginated listing and presigned URLs, tested offline with moto
results.summary: A small boto3 S3 helper for upload, paginated listing, presigned GET URLs and batched delete, tested offline with moto's mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: Bottleneck rate limiting with concurrency, spacing and retries
results.summary: Throttle calls to a flaky API with Bottleneck using maxConcurrent, minTime spacing, priorities and automatic retries from the failed event, checked offline with timestamps.

results.title: Cheerio HTML scraping with Zod-validated records and saved fixtures
results.summary: Scrape a product listing and a spec table with Cheerio, normalise prices and relative URLs, and validate every record with Zod 4 so broken cards are reported, tested offline against saved HTML fixtures.
